synopsis: A neglected, debris-filled backyard is meticulously transformed into a serene and minimalist Japanese Zen garden.

shots.prompt: Medium shot of a cluttered backyard, half-cleared, with an old rusty bicycle frame and scattered pots still visible, contrasting with a freshly raked patch of fine white gravel in the foreground. Workers are carefully sifting soil, preparing the ground.

Dynamic wide shot, showing the rapid transformation: workers laying down weed barriers, carefully placing large, smooth river stones and shaping the landscape. A small, elegant wooden bridge is swiftly assembled over a dry stream bed. Time-lapse effect emphasizes the efficiency and precision.

Extreme close-up on gloved hands meticulously arranging small, smooth river pebbles around the base of a newly planted, perfectly pruned bonsai tree. Each stone is placed with intention, contributing to the balance and harmony of the miniature landscape. A gentle mist rises from a nearby sprinkler.

Serene wide shot revealing the completed Japanese Zen garden. A meticulously raked gravel "ocean" surrounds carefully placed, naturally sculpted rock formations. A delicate wooden bridge crosses a dry riverbed, and a small, vibrant bonsai tree adds a touch of life, all bathed in soft, golden hour sunlight. A single, distant figure meditates peacefully.

music: A contemplative and evolving percussive track, starting with a subtle, almost hesitant rhythm, then gradually introducing natural sounds and more defined beats as elements are placed, reflecting the methodical nature of the transformation. It softens into a serene, meditative flow for the final reveal, creating a peaceful, looping atmosphere.
